# cycle_provider_server_models (Data Source)

Lists server models available from a Cycle provider integration. Use this to choose a `model_id` for `cycle_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List server models advertised by a provider integration.
data "cycle_provider_server_models" "equinix" {
  integration_id = var.provider_integration_id
}

output "compatible_model_ids" {
  value = [
    for model in data.cycle_provider_server_models.equinix.models : model.id
    if model.compatible
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) The provider integration ID to list server models for.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) Server models advertised by the provider integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The provider category for this model.
- `compatible` (Boolean) Whether Cycle currently supports this model.
- `description` (String) A description of the server model.
- `id` (String) The server model ID.
- `location_ids` (List of String) Location IDs where this model is available.
- `low_resource` (Boolean) Whether this model has limited resources and should only be used for lightweight workloads.
- `model` (String) The provider-specific model identifier.
- `name` (String) The server model name.
